title: Logistics
description: Origin and destination geohashes plus shipment mass and volume. Composed when an order moves physical goods between locations. Handling class is its own elective clause (figaro-class-of-service).

fields.name: originGeohash
fields.description: Origin geohash (base32). 1–12 characters; longer = higher precision. Default "0" is the minimal valid placeholder (whole-region cell) pending a real value at commit time.

fields.name: destinationGeohash
fields.description: Destination geohash (base32). 1–12 characters; longer = higher precision. Default "0" is the minimal valid placeholder (whole-region cell) pending a real value at commit time.

fields.name: massGrams
fields.description: Shipment mass in whole grams. Must be at least 1 g; capped at uint32 max (≈4.29 million kg).

fields.name: volumeMl
fields.description: Shipment volume in whole millilitres. Must be at least 1 ml; capped at uint32 max (≈4.29 million L).
